verdict.rationale: Virtual Mail (formerly Earth Class Mail) documents an official MCP server. It lets users manage the mailbox "just by asking" from Claude, Cursor and other MCP apps, including finding mail, scanning, shredding, tagging and moving items, and a live machine-readable tool catalog backs it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed, and a native in-app natural-language interface (operation depends on an external MCP-compatible assistant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect your AI assistant to Virtual Mail and manage your virtual mailbox just by asking - find mail, organize your inbox, scan or shred items, and more - directly from Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible apps.
Instead of logging in and clicking through the app, you just ask
A machine-readable MCP tool catalog is served live at the API origin under /v2/.
